description: One direct message between two members of the workspace. A row is written once by the sender and read by the recipient through the `recipientId` filter (rules.json keeps the collection readable workspace-wide). `readAt` is stamped by the recipient's client to drive unread badges and read ticks; it stays empty until then.

fields.name: senderId
fields.description: IAM sub of the sender. Duplicates the platform's CreatedBy audit field, but an explicit column keeps the filter + selector self-documenting and immune to rows with a null CreatedBy.

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: IAM sub of the recipient — the inbox filter key (`recipientId: me`).

fields.name: content
fields.description: Message text. Optional so an image-only message (attachmentFileId set, content empty) is a valid row — the bubble renders the attachment in place of text in that case. Roster previews fall back to a localized 'Image' label when content is empty. After a delete, this is blanked and `deletedAt` carries the timestamp; the bubble renders a tombstone in that state.

fields.name: readAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp set by the recipient's client when the message is seen; empty string while unread.

fields.name: attachmentFileId
fields.description: Blocks Data Storage file id of an optional image attached to this message (returned by the presign/PUT flow used for profile pictures). Empty string when the message has no attachment. Receivers render the image via files.get on this id.

fields.name: reactions
fields.description: JSON-encoded array of {userId, emoji} pairs representing the reactions on this message. Empty string when no reactions. The schema is intentionally flat (one row per message, reactions packed into a string field) so reads stay single-query — reactions are bounded by the small emoji alphabet (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏 🎉 🔥) so the array stays short.

fields.name: editedAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp set by the sender the last time they edited the message content. Empty string when the message has never been edited. Bubbles render an '(edited)' indicator next to the timestamp when this is non-empty.

fields.name: deletedAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp set by the sender when they deleted the message. Empty string while the message is live. The bubble renders a tombstone ('This message was deleted') instead of the content + attachment when this is non-empty — soft delete so the row stays around for unread/read tracking.

fields.name: messageType
fields.description: 'call_log' for system messages that summarize a voice/video call; empty string for regular text/attachment. Renderer branches on this to swap the bubble for a centered pill.

fields.name: callSummary
fields.description: Localized human-readable summary rendered by the thread pill and the roster preview (e.g. 'Voice call · 5:32', 'Missed voice call'). Empty string for regular messages and for the rare case where summary isn't known yet.
